positions.title: Marketing Specialist
positions.description:
The planning and implementing of multi-media content based on your marketing needs to reach more people, grow your client-base, and engage with your audience. 

1. Outlined, planned, and executed multi-media strategy including video, audio, social, blog, and newsletter.

2. Managing of (building, creating, maintaining) Facebook, IG, and Twitters ads to increase social engagement and brand awareness

3. Attracting leads via social channels with posts designed to inform potential clients about the available legal services and to engage with local audience.

positions.title: Search Engine Optimization Specialist
positions.description:
-Implementation of updates to Wordpress-based website using CSS and
HTML to improve the visual aspects and client-side usability of
MapleMudPermaculture.com
-Production of video, written, and visual content related to physical and
mental health, permaculture, organic gardening, duck keeping, cat care,
and rainwater collection
-Planning, writing, and researching of new content based on SEO
evaluations of sought-after information via the Google search engine
suggestions
-Website content maintenance, including updating of SEO descriptions of
image, video, and article snippets to retain search-engine rankings
-Creation of additional visual content for each article designed to increase
social sharing in partnership with Coschedule software
-Creation and maintenance of multiple newsletters dedicated to differing
sub-niches within the blog with content relevant to those sub-niches
Execution of scheduled SEO research related to permaculture, organic
gardening, poultry raising, domestic feline care, and agroforestry in order
to increase organic web traffic through relevant web searches of long tail
keywords

Technologies: Trello, Coschedule, Monday.com, Gmail, Gsuite, Siteground,
Bluehost, GoDaddy

positions.title: Marketing Manager
positions.description:
-Maintaining monthly budget and allotting funds for advertising efforts
based on analytical reports and effectiveness of ads
-Assist with budgeting and forecasting as needed.
-Support external audits by providing documentation and information.
-Filing daily financial transactions, including sales, purchases, receipts,
payments, and bank deposits,
-Filing of purchase orders and justifications for expense reports to
accounting department
-Monthly presentation of advertising analytics and suggestions for
adjustment to improve profit margin and brand visibility
-Preparation of invoices for contracted talent based on content advertising
needs to file with accounting department via Quickbooks
-Daily usage of social media planning and management software,
Coschedule to manage a team of seven including: scriptwriters, a video
production crew, visual designers, and content writers
-Analysis of PPC campaigns from third party marketing service, and
Facebook and Instagram, social media sites including Twitter and Tiktok
-Creation of web, social media, television, and ad content for legal
marketing for bankruptcy, car/ truck accidents, workplace compensation,
and social security
-Maintained communication with Sales Representative of Lamar
Advertising Company to design and implement new billboards to support
the marketing efforts of the law firm
-Designed ads for online marketing campaigns for car accident attorneys,
bankruptcy filing, workers’ compensation, and community service efforts
-Used Geo tracking to measure and compare the number of potential
clients (those who viewed the online ads) vs those who made attended
appointments with law firm attorneys within a month's time of initial
viewing
-Scheduled and coordinated quarterly sit-downs to go through analytical
reports of Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter, TV commercial, billboard, and
digital ad spends for budget adjustments
positions.insights: Skills: Video Editing · Facebook Marketing · Strategic Marketing Management · Advertising · Bookkeeping · Wordpress Development
